description:
Bill of Materials (BOM) for CloudForge — import as type pom / scope import.
    Reactor modules: cloudforge-core, cloudforge-api. cloudforge-ministack and cloudforge-localstack
    live in their own repos (CloudForgeCI/cloudforge-ministack, CloudForgeCI/cloudforge-localstack),
    declaring this pom as their Maven parent, but are not managed BOM coordinates here and
    cloudforge-api has no dependency on either — see publish-release-branch.yml, which publishes
    them as a side effect of a cfc-core release, the only relationship cfc-core has to them.
    cloudforge-manager-deployment and cloudforge-manager are also not part of this
    BOM/reactor — split into their own private repos
    (CloudForgeCI/cloudforge-manager-deployment, CloudForgeCI/cloudforge-manager), each with a
    standalone pom.xml and independent versioning.
    See docs/architecture/cloudforge-sample-bom.template.md and
    docs/architecture/module-boundaries-and-refactor.plan.md.
